briefing:
ANTHROPIC: PRE-CALL BRIEFING

Note: This is written from my own knowledge, which has a cutoff date. Figures and recent developments may be out of date, so verify anything critical before quoting it on the call.

OVERVIEW
Anthropic is an AI safety and research company based in San Francisco, founded in 2021. It is structured as a public benefit corporation, and its stated mission is building reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. It sells primarily to enterprises and developers through an API and also runs a consumer-facing assistant. Safety positioning is a core part of its brand and a common selling point with regulated industries.

LEADERSHIP
Dario Amodei is CEO and Daniela Amodei is President. Both were previously at OpenAI before co-founding Anthropic with a group of other former OpenAI researchers, including Jared Kaplan, Jack Clark, Sam McCandlish, Tom Brown, and Chris Olah. Mike Krieger, co-founder of Instagram, joined as Chief Product Officer in 2024.

FUNDING AND FINANCIALS
Anthropic has raised well over $10 billion in total. Amazon has committed up to $8 billion, and Google has invested around $2 billion or more. Other investors include Spark Capital, Menlo Ventures, and Lightspeed. Valuation has climbed steeply: roughly $18 billion in early 2024, then reportedly $60 billion or more by 2025, with later rounds reportedly higher. Annualized revenue was reported in the low single-digit billions in 2024 to 2025 and growing quickly, driven largely by API and enterprise usage. Treat any specific number as approximate.

PRODUCTS
Claude is the core model family, offered in tiers (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus) that trade speed and cost against capability. Access comes through the Claude app, Claude API, and cloud platforms including Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud Vertex AI. Claude Code is a coding agent for developers. Team and Enterprise plans add admin controls and security features. Key differentiators typically cited are long context windows, coding strength, and strong safety practices.

RECENT NEWS
Themes I'm aware of: frequent new Claude model releases, rapid enterprise adoption, expanded agentic and coding tools, and ongoing debate about AI regulation, where Anthropic is a vocal participant. Check recent headlines for anything newer.
